purpose: Original inputs for independent baseline/candidate semantic evaluation; not scored or generated by this fixture file

cases.brief: 一名修电梯的临时工被扣工资，想保住住处。他能从电机的细小声音辨别故障，却没有资格签维修单。写他第一次凭真实本事争回一项选择权，语言像好读的商业网文。

A seasonal harbor mechanic needs a paid place on the winter crew. She notices a defect the licensed team missed, but reporting it may cost her only reference. Give her an active first foothold in concrete, natural English.
最末等药圃杂役得到一个能看见植物明日状态的能力，但每天只能看一株。他想争取免除连带赔偿，管事却要维持旧账。允许明显爽感和主流外挂，别把胜利全交给系统。

An untrained station cleaner wakes in an abandoned orbital habitat with limited oxygen and a maintenance map only she can partly read. Her first gain should be a usable improvement in freedom or safety. No obligatory sneering villain or instant mastery.
失去雇主的账房助手在粮船码头找活路。一个地位更高的人也被坏账困住，两人都需要对方。写利益交换中由主角判断带来的第一项真实回报，不强加打斗或恶毒亲戚。

A penniless apprentice takes over a neglected greenhouse and wants a reliable income. The town already has capable growers, so success must come from a specific useful discovery and choice. Keep the pleasure warm and low-stress without adding a punishment to every gain.

Explicitly write a quiet first-person family mystery rather than an underdog victory serial. A returned letter changes a daughter's understanding of why her father left. Preserve a deliberate open emotional ending and do not invent a public antagonist.
只写一个完整短篇：夜班洗碗工想追回被栽赃扣掉的工资，用自己记住的送货时间找出漏洞。核心利益在本篇有因果成立的结局和情绪回报，不留下一章才能完成的高潮。

procedure: Generate baseline and candidate from the same original brief, model and saved length contract in separate isolated directories, never from an existing private manuscript.
Record whether each stage completed and retain actual prompts, plans and prose separately from review results. Preserve failed attempts rather than replacing them silently.
Blind the reader to baseline/candidate identity. First read prose alone and summarize what happens, what is wanted, what blocks it, what the protagonist contributes and what changes.

Then compare with the supplied brief and plan. Cite exact prose for strengths, defects, missing evidence and intentional ambiguity. Check the first short reading window separately from the whole chapter.

Judge stage-appropriate return, final closure when requested, natural language and distinct mechanisms. Do not force one event order, every chapter victory, misery, a villain, or a numeric popularity score.
Report preference with reasons and uncertainty, including regressions and ties. Protocol tests or self-ratings cannot substitute for this evaluation.
